method: Built-in image_gen tool; precise-object-edit; native Android draws branding and all controls separately
layout: Each PNG is one background atlas: light portrait on the left, dark portrait on the right. No rendered UI in the atlas.
reference_fidelity: Background scenery reconstructed from user-supplied UI boards. Not a pixel-identical crop of the reference.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one two-column texture atlas for Android splash backgrounds. Input is the SUMUWW Spring UI reference board. Reconstruct ONLY the scenery background of its FIRST narrow splash phone in each row, preserving the arrangement and palette as closely as possible, while removing the phone border, all text, logos, progress bars and status/navigation bars. Output ONE square image with TWO equal edge-to-edge portrait panels with no gutter: LEFT panel matches the light splash (ivory paper, fresh sage stems and small yellow-white wildflowers rising from lower-left and top edges, soft sunlight, spacious ivory center); RIGHT panel matches the dark splash (deep charcoal sage, stems crossing from upper-left, softly illuminated ivory wildflowers and fresh leaves clustered near bottom-left, spacious calm dark center). Exactly two vertical panels; do not include ANY letters, logos, UI, controls or device mockup. This image is background art only; native app components are added separately. Match the supplied scene and material, do not redesign or add new objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one two-column texture atlas for Android splash backgrounds. Input is the SUMUWW Summer UI reference board.
